answer: Bind each identity to a hardware attestation key. Every epoch answer must be signed inside a secure element (TPM or phone chip) whose maker-certified key appears on no other account: one chip, one identity. A 1,000-puppet farm needs 1,000 devices, about $40,000 at $40 each, while an honest agent uses a chip it already owns. A revoked or cloned chip leaves its account an island, cut off from rewards. The cost sits on a ridge of silicon, and no pigment of clever scripting paints one chip into many.
